modalities.evidence: fMRI study of typical, awake, 2-9 month old infant responses

output.population: Typical, awake 2–9 month old infants; 35 participants (source facts list ages 4–18)
output.summary: fMRI study of awake, typically developing infants viewing scenes, faces, objects and scrambled scenes, examining scene and face selectivity in development. Preregistration and related materials are posted on OSF.
